description: The plot illustrates the loss values for Ex1 and Ex2 during the training process, as well as their respective validation losses. The x-axis represents the number of steps, while the y-axis shows the loss values on a logarithmic scale. The Ex1 Loss starts at a high value and decreases sharply before stabilizing. The Ex2 Loss begins at a lower value and decreases more gradually, also stabilizing at a lower value than the Ex1 Loss. The Ex1 Validation Loss and Ex2 Validation Loss follow a similar trend to their respective training losses, with the Ex1 Validation Loss starting higher and decreasing more sharply than the Ex2 Validation Loss.
